subject: Future Tech
title: A Brief History of Autonomy
description: Learn A Brief History of Autonomy in one minute.

hook.text: In 1925, a radio-controlled car drove through Manhattan traffic with no one at the wheel. The dream is a century old.

buildup.text: In the 1980s, Carnegie Mellon built Navlab, a van that could steer itself on highways using computer vision.

twist.text: The DARPA challenge launched a generation of AV engineers. Google hired the winning team and started Project Chauffeur.

climax.text: By 2015, every major automaker and tech giant was racing to build self-driving cars.

punchline.text: A century of dreaming, now a decade from reality.
